STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_11725_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_11725_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11725 (
  input   wire    CLK,
  input   wire    RESETn,
  output  wire    By2CLK,
  output  wire    By4CLK,
  output  wire    By8CLK,
  output  wire    By16CLK,
  output  wire    By32CLK
);

  reg [4:0]   counter;

  reg         by2clk_r;
  reg         by4clk_r;
  reg         by8clk_r;
  reg         by16clk_r;
  reg         by32clk_r;

  always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
    if(~RESETn)
      counter <= 5'h0;
    else 
      counter <= counter + 1'b1;
  end

  always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
    if(~RESETn) begin
      by2clk_r    <= 1'b0;
      by4clk_r    <= 1'b0;
      by8clk_r    <= 1'b0;
      by16clk_r   <= 1'b0;
      by32clk_r   <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      by2clk_r    <= ~counter[0];
      by4clk_r    <= ~counter[1];
      by8clk_r    <= ~counter[2];
      by16clk_r   <= ~counter[3];
      by32clk_r   <= ~counter[4];
    end
  end

  assign By2CLK   = by2clk_r;
  assign By4CLK   = by4clk_r;
  assign By8CLK   = by8clk_r;
  assign By16CLK  = by16clk_r;
  assign By32CLK  = by32clk_r;

endmodule
